en.title: Role and limit map
en.caption: This lesson uses four relationships as an authored teaching organizer, not an official four-category chain of command.

cards.label: Community: concerns and choices.
cards.detail: Listen and clarify with them rather than treating them as passive recipients.

cards.label: Health professional: authorized guidance.
cards.detail: A BHW or peer does not replace professional assessment.

cards.label: Officials: administrative support.
cards.detail: Support depends on local roles and available resources; it is not guaranteed.

cards.label: Peers: routine tasks and experience.
cards.detail: Peer advice does not become clinical authority.

fil.title: Balangkas ng papel at hangganan
fil.caption: Ginagamit sa araling ito ang apat na ugnayan bilang ginawang balangkas sa pagtuturo, hindi opisyal na apat na antas ng pamamahala.

cards.label: Komunidad: alalahanin at pagpili.
cards.detail: Makinig at maglinaw kasama nila; hindi lamang sila tagatanggap ng tulong.

cards.label: Health professional: awtorisadong gabay.
cards.detail: Hindi kapalit ng propesyonal na pagtatasa ang BHW o kapwa BHW.

cards.label: Opisyal: suportang administratibo.
cards.detail: Nakasalalay ang suporta sa lokal na papel at magagamit na kagamitan; walang garantiya.

cards.label: Kapwa BHW: karaniwang gawain at karanasan.
cards.detail: Hindi nagiging klinikal na awtoridad ang payo ng kapwa BHW.

en.title: Known and still to clarify
en.caption: Repeat, clarify and invite the resident to correct your understanding.

cards.label: Known
cards.detail: Malou knows that Nena has two questions.

cards.label: Still to clarify
cards.detail: She still needs to confirm the venue, the locally designated professional contact, and Nena's preferred way to ask.

fil.title: Alam at kailangan pang linawin
fil.caption: Ulitin, linawin at hayaang itama ng residente ang iyong pagkaunawa.

cards.label: Alam
cards.detail: Alam: may dalawang tanong si Nena.

cards.label: Kailangan pang linawin
cards.detail: Hindi pa alam: ang tiyak na lugar, ang lokal na itinalagang propesyonal na contact at ang paraang nais ni Nena sa pagtatanong.

en.title: Concern → confirmed role
en.caption: This is an organizational example, not medical triage or a universal referral sequence.
en.question: Ask whether it is within the contact’s role.

fil.title: Alalahanin → natiyak na papel
fil.caption: Halimbawang pang-organisasyon ito, hindi medikal na triage o iisang proseso ng referral para sa lahat.
fil.question: Itanong kung saklaw ng kaniyang papel.

en.title: Four practice cards
en.caption: Match each to an appropriate locally confirmed role, then explain the limits.

fil.title: Apat na practice card
fil.caption: Itugma sa angkop na papel na tiniyak sa lokalidad, saka ipaliwanag ang hangganan.
